items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: My mother's maiden name was Hattie Lee Spense

ctx.x: about. About your mother and your father, can we have their names on their tape?

My mother's maiden name was Hattie Lee Spense, and my father's name was George Lawrence Callender. So although my name is George Sylvester Callender... I'm a junior, but I guess that wouldn't be approved on me because my middle name is different than my father's. But anyhow, they used to call me George Junior Callender. And I can remember when I first went to school and my father took me, and said, "George Callender, Junior," and I said, "no, my name is George Junior Callender." I finally figured it out that my…
When you mentioned the Sylvester in the beginning, that was from the Bajan?
